name: Tablet of Verga
summary: In Skull Rock, the Tablet of Verga lies in Burning Blade hands, its demonic runes sought by warlocks in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Stolen Relic
sections.body: The Tablet of Verga bears ritual runes for summoning creatures of the Nether and bending them to a master's will. The Burning Blade cult stole the stone and hid it in a chest inside Skull Rock, just east of Orgrimmar. Warlocks in the Cleft of Shadow seek it to study the markings and learn to summon a voidwalker. Recovering it also keeps the cult from gaining that same advantage.

faq.q: Where is the Tablet of Verga located?
aliases: where to find tablet of verga
faq.answer: The Tablet of Verga is hidden in a Burning Blade Stash inside Skull Rock, a cavern complex crawling with cultists just east of Orgrimmar in Durotar.

faq.q: Who wants the Tablet of Verga recovered?
aliases: who do i bring tablet of verga to
faq.answer: Gan'rul Bloodeye, a master warlock in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar, sends initiates to retrieve the tablet so he can teach them to summon greater minions.

faq.q: What power does the tablet contain?
faq.answer: The stone bears ancient runes needed to summon and bind a voidwalker, a creature drawn from the Twisting Nether.

faq.q: Why did the Burning Blade steal it?
aliases: why do burning blade have tablet
faq.answer: The Burning Blade cult seeks to disrupt the Horde and increase its demonic power. Stealing the tablet denies Orgrimmar's practitioners key ritual knowledge while the cult keeps it for itself.

angles.text: As a warlock training in Orgrimmar, recovering the tablet marks a step toward proving your worth to the Horde and learning to bind a defensive voidwalker servant.
As a member of the Horde, you face the Burning Blade close to Orgrimmar's gates. Taking stolen relics from the cult strikes at its influence over Thrall's fledgling nation.
